answer: Sybil cost grows when each identity must keep a private whisper ledger of time-locked peer endorsements. New accounts wander a random multi-day path of signed micro-attestations through distinct notaries; shared operators collide on schedule and fail the path together. Collateral sits in a karst of nested escrows that deepen with every extra sibling, so N fakes lock N escalating stakes and N non-parallel calendars.
